description:
Look up components, systems and jobs in one car's manual index, e.g. "timing chain",
"camshaft position sensor", "a/t fluid", "spark plug", "brake caliper". 'manual' is required:
a manual from find_manuals, or its model folder to cover all years. The query is split into the
manual's index terms; pages holding all of them come first, and pages where a bookmark names a
term (where the manual's own index would point) rank above passing mentions. An abbreviation the
manual doesn't use is read as the term it does ("bsm" -> "blind spot"), and "timing" alone (or "timing
diagram", "timing marks") as the timing chain/belt job, both shown under 'read_as'. A word for the
kind of page beside the part ("fuel pump wiring diagram", "... connector", "... specifications") ranks the
part's pages headed that way first (shown under 'page_kind'). Words not in the
index are listed under 'not_indexed' with index terms that start the same way; an engine code the
manual doesn't cover (engine, transmission, chassis or model) is listed under 'not_here' with the codes
of that kind the manual does cover and the model folders whose manuals print it. Only English text is
indexed; a book in another language is listed by get_contents and read_pages reads it.
name: search
title: Search a manual
